body.name: Nonlinear-factor separation witness
body.construction: Draw independent \(u^{\mathrm D}_i,v^{\mathrm D}_j\sim\operatorname{Uniform}(0,1)\), set \(f^{\mathrm D}_0(u,v)=0\) and \(f^{\mathrm D}_1(u,v)=\exp(uv)\), and form \(M^{\mathrm D}_{ij}=\exp(u^{\mathrm D}_iv^{\mathrm D}_j)\).
inputs: Independent unit and time factors on a compact positive interval.
